title: Ziyarat of Muslim ibn Aqil & Hani ibn Urwa
urduTitle: زیارت مسلم بن عقیل اور ہانی بن عروہ
intro: The source edition includes separate visitations of Muslim ibn Aqil and Hani ibn Urwa in Kufa.
description: Read Ziyarat of Muslim ibn Aqil & Hani ibn Urwa with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.text: Ziyarat of Muslim ibn Aqeel and Hani ibn Urwa

Muslim ibn Aqeel was the son of Aqeel ibn Abi Talib, and therefore was a first cousin to Imam Husayn (peace be upon him). The Imam (peace be upon him) sent Muslim as his ambassador to Kufa, where Muslim (peace be upon him) was brutally murdered by the Umayyads on the 9th of Dhul-hijjah. His shrine is within the Premises of the Masjid Kufa near Najaf Iraq

blocks.english: All praise be to Allah: the Lord and the evident Truth.
All the tyrannical oppressors are subservient to His almightiness.

blocks.arabic: ٱلْمُعْتَرِفِ بِرُبُوبِيَّتِهِ جَمِيعُ أَهْلِ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلأَرَضِينَ
blocks.transliteration: almu`tarifi birububiyyatihi jami`u ahli alssamawati wal-aradina
blocks.english: All the inhabitants of the heavens and the layers of the earth admit His Godhead.
All the created beings confess of His Oneness.
May Allah send blessings upon the master of all created beings
and upon the members of his Household; the noble ones,
such blessings that delight them
and humiliate all those who antagonize them
from all jinn and mankind.
Peace of Allah the All-high and All-great,
and peace of His favorite angels,
His missioned Prophets,
His choice Imams,
His righteous servants,
and all the martyrs and veracious ones,
and all blessings that are pure and delightful,
that are coming and going,

blocks.arabic: عَلَيْكَ يَا مُسْلِمُ بْنَ عَقِيلِ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ
blocks.transliteration: `alayka ya muslimu bna `aqili bni abi talibin
blocks.english: be upon you, Muslim the son of `Aqil the son of Abu-Talib.
Allah’s mercy and benedictions be upon you.
I bear witness that you performed the prayers,
defrayed the zakat,
enjoined the right,
forbade the wrong,

blocks.transliteration: wa jahadta fi allahi haqqa jihadihi
blocks.english: strove in the way of Allah in the best manner of striving,

blocks.arabic: وَقُتِلْتَ عَلَىٰ مِنْهَاجِ ٱلْمُجَاهِدِينَ فِي سَبِيلِهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa qutilta `ala minhaji almujahidina fi sabilihi
blocks.english: and you were slain following the course of those who strive in Allah’s way

blocks.arabic: حَتَّىٰ لَقِيتَ ٱللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ وَهُوَ عَنْكَ رَاضٍ
blocks.transliteration: hatta laqita allaha `azza wa jalla wa huwa `anka radin
blocks.english: until you met Allah, to Whom belong all might and majesty, while He is pleased with you.

blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka wafayta bi`ahdi allahi
blocks.english: And I bear witness that you fulfilled your covenant with Allah

blocks.arabic: وَبَذَلْتَ نَفْسَكَ فِي نُصْرَةِ حُجَّةِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنِ حُجَّتِهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa badhalta nafsaka fi nusrati hujjati allahi wabni hujjatihi
blocks.english: and sacrificed yourself for the sake of supporting Allah’s argument and the son of Allah’s argument (namely, Imam al-Husayn)
until death came upon you.
I bear witness that you submitted and acted loyally to him
and that you acted sincerely to the successor of the missioned Prophet,
the select grandson (of the Prophet),
the guide (to the right path), the knowledgeable,
the Prophet’s successor, the conveyor (of his mission),
the wronged, and the oppressed Imam.
May Allah reward you on behalf of His Messenger,
on behalf of the Commander of the Faithful,
and on behalf of al-Hasan and al-Husayn
with the best of rewarding

blocks.transliteration: bima sabarta wa ihtasabta wa a`anta
blocks.english: that befits your steadfastness, reliance (on Allah), and assistance.
How excellent is the final home!
May Allah curse him who slew you.

blocks.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu man amara biqatlika
blocks.english: May Allah curse him who ordered of slaying you.
May Allah curse him who wronged you.
May Allah curse him who forged lies against you.

blocks.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu man jahila haqqaka
blocks.english: May Allah curse him who underestimated your position
and belittled your sanctity.

blocks.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu man baya`aka wa ghashshaka
blocks.english: May Allah curse those who cheated you after they had sworn allegiance to you,
those who disappointed and let you down,

blocks.transliteration: wa man allaba `alayka wa lam yu`inka
blocks.english: and those who allied against you instead of assisting you.

blocks.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ ٱلنَّارَ مَثْوَاهُمْ
blocks.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi ja`ala alnnara mathwahum
blocks.english: All praise be to Allah Who decided Hellfire to be the eternal abode of those peoples.
Woeful indeed will be the place to which they are led!
I bear witness that you were slain wrongly

blocks.arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُنْجِزٌ لَكُمْ مَا وَعَدَكُمْ
blocks.transliteration: wa anna allaha munjizun lakum ma wa`adakum
blocks.english: and that Allah shall fulfill His promise to you.
As I am visiting you, I recognize your right,
I am submissive to you,
I am imitating your course,
and I am preparing myself for supporting you

blocks.arabic: حَتَّىٰ يَحْكُمَ ٱللَّهُ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلْحَاكِمِينَ
blocks.transliteration: hatta yahkuma allahu wa huwa khayru alhakimina
blocks.english: until Allah judges, and He is the best of judges.
So, I am always with you
and I never am with your enemies.
May Allah’s peace be upon you
and upon your souls and bodies
and upon the present from you and the absent one.

blocks.transliteration: wa alssalamu `alaykum wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
blocks.english: Peace and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.

blocks.arabic: قَتَلَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً قَتَلَتْكُمْ بِٱلأَيْدِي وَٱلأَلْسُنِ
blocks.transliteration: qatala allahu ummatan qatalatkum bilaydi wal-alsuni
blocks.english: May Allah kill the groups that have killed you with deeds and words.
Peace of Allah the All-great and His blessings
be upon you, Hani' the son of `Urwah.
Peace be upon you, O righteous servant (of Allah),

blocks.transliteration: alnnasihu lillahi wa lirasulihi wa li'amiri almu'minina
blocks.english: who acted sincerely for the sake of Allah, His Messenger, the Commander of the Faithful,
al-Hasan, and al-Husayn, peace be upon them.
I bear witness that you were slain wrongly.

blocks.arabic: فَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ قَتَلَكَ وَٱسْتَحَلَّ دَمَكَ
blocks.transliteration: fala`ana allahu man qatalaka wastahalla damaka
blocks.english: So, may Allah curse those who slew you and dared to shed your blood
and may He stuff their graves with fire.

blocks.arabic: اشْهَدُ انَّكَ لَقِيتَ ٱللَّهَ وَهُوَ رَاضٍ عَنْكَ
blocks.transliteration: ashhadu annaka laqita allaha wa huwa radin `anka
blocks.english: I bear witness that you met Allah while He is pleased with You
for what you did and acted sincerely.

blocks.arabic: وَاشْهَدُ انَّكَ قَدْ بَلَغْتَ دَرَجَةَ ٱلشُّهَدَاءِ
blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka qad balaghta darajata alshshuhada'i
blocks.english: And I bear witness that you have attained the rank of the martyrs,

blocks.transliteration: wa ju`ila ruhuka ma`a arwahi alssu`ada'i
blocks.english: your soul has been included with the souls of the delighted ones

blocks.transliteration: bima nasahta lillahi wa lirasulihi mujtahidan
blocks.english: for you painstakingly acted with sincerity for Allah and for His Messenger,

blocks.arabic: وَبَذَلْتَ نَفْسَكَ فِي ذَاتِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَرْضَاتِهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa badhalta nafsaka fi dhati allahi wa mardatihi
blocks.english: and sacrificed yourself for the sake of Allah and for the sake of attaining His pleasure.
So, may Allah have mercy upon you and be pleased with you,

blocks.transliteration: wa hasharaka ma`a muhammadin wa alihi alttahirina
blocks.english: may He include you with the group of Muhammad and his Immaculate Household,

blocks.arabic: وَجَمَعَنَا وَإِيَّاكُمْ مَعَهُمْ فِي دَارِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
blocks.transliteration: wa jama`ana wa iyyakum ma`ahum fi dari alnna`imi
blocks.english: and may He gather us with you and them in the Abode of Bliss.

blocks.transliteration: wa salamun `alayka wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
blocks.english: Peace and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.

blocks.text: Izn Dukhool - Permission to Enter the shrine

al-Mazar al-Kabir, the previously mentioned supplication is regarded as a form of seeking permission of entrance to the tomb of Muslim ibn `Aqil, may Allah be pleased with him. The author then says: You may then enter, approach the tomb -or point to the tomb, according to the previous narration- and say the following words

blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O righteous servant (of Allah),

blocks.transliteration: almuti`u lillahi wa lirasulihi wa li'amiri almu'minina
blocks.english: who is obedient to Allah, to His Messenger, to the Commander of the Faithful,
to al-Hasan, and to al-Husayn, peace be upon them.
All praise be to Allah
and all peace be upon His servants whom He has chosen:
Muhammad and his Household.
Peace, Allah’s mercy,
blessings, and forgiveness be upon you
and upon your soul and your body.

blocks.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ مَضَيْتَ عَلَىٰ مَا مَضَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْبَدْرِيُّونَ
blocks.transliteration: ashhadu annaka madayta `ala ma mada `alayhi albadriyyuna
blocks.english: I bear witness that you died for the same principles for which the martyrs of the Battle of Badr died:
those who strove in Allah’s way
and did their best in struggling against Allah’s enemies
and in supporting Allah’s friends.
So, may Allah reward you with the best rewarding,
with the most abundant rewarding,

blocks.arabic: وَأَوْفَرَ جَزَاءِ أَحَدٍ مِمَّنْ وَفَىٰ بِبَيْعَتِهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa awfara jaza'i ahadin mimman wafa bibay`atihi
blocks.english: and with the most affluent rewarding that He grants to one who fulfilled his allegiance to Him,
responded to His invitation,
and obeyed His representatives.

blocks.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ قَدْ بَالَغْتَ فِي ٱلنَّصِيحَةِ
blocks.transliteration: ashhadu annaka qad balaghta fi alnnasihati
blocks.english: I bear witness that you exerted all efforts in acting sincerely
and you put forth all possible endeavors
so that Allah has included you with the martyrs,

blocks.transliteration: wa ja`ala ruhaka ma`a arwahi alssu`ada'i
blocks.english: put your soul with the souls of the delighted ones,

blocks.transliteration: wa a`taka min jinanihi afsahaha manzilan
blocks.english: has decided for you the most spacious abode in the gardens of His Paradise
and the best rooms therein,
raised your name to the `illiyyin (the loftiest place),
and added you to the group of the Prophets, the veracious ones,
the martyrs, and the righteous ones.
How excellent is the company of these.

blocks.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ لَمْ تَهِنْ وَلَمْ تَنْكُلْ
blocks.transliteration: ashhadu annaka lam tahin wa lam tankul
blocks.english: I bear witness that you never slackened or recoiled (from your duty)

blocks.arabic: وَأَنَّكَ قَدْ مَضَيْتَ عَلَىٰ بَصِيرَةٍ مِنْ أَمْرِكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa annaka qad madayta `ala basiratin min amrika
blocks.english: and that you died while you are certain of your doctrine
as you followed the righteous ones
and imitated the Prophets.
So, may Allah gather us with you
and with His Messenger and intimate servants
in the abodes of the modest ones.
Surely, He is the most merciful of all those who show mercy.

blocks.text: You may then offer a two-unit prayer at the side of his head and present this prayer as your gift to him. Then, you may say the prayer which is said at the end of the Ziyarah recited in holy shrine of al-`Abbas (sa)

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت مسلم بن عقیل اور ہانی بن عروہ کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
